Would Redwood be available for a short pre-flight call (30–40 min) next week to walk through the items and confirm scope / data residency commitments?

- Tue 8/22 10:00–10:40

- Wed 8/23 09:00–09:40

Thanks all — I reviewed Novus’s initial redline and flagged three items that typically need a short discussion: audit scope, breach notification timelines, and liability carve-outs for customer data handled by third-party inference partners. I’ve attached a slimmed-down comment file (redline highlights) so we don’t duplicate work on the call.

Two quick notes for the preflight:
- Please confirm whether Novus needs SOC2 evidence or the full audit report; if SOC2 only, we can provide our attestation and the control mapping.
- If there are specific regulatory constraints (HIPAA/PHI rules), call that out up front so Naomi and I can bring the right docs and an implementation memo.

Attachment: [security-evidence-matrix.xlsx] (summary of attestations + where artifacts live)

I’ll be on the call and prepared to commit timing for evidence delivery windows.

— Diego Fernandez
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
